_comment: Position-management ruleset. Copy to ~/.cherrypick/config/manage.json and keep only what you change: the file is merged key by key over this default, and a key the default does not have is reported, not applied. Every rule carries `confidence` (0-100), reported beside its verdict. Money is gross of fees.

credit._comment: A trade opened for a net credit. capture = share of the credit kept; stop fires when the loss reaches loss_multiple_of_credit x the credit; time_exit acts at the nearest short's DTE (a winner may roll, a loser closes).

debit._comment: A trade opened for a net debit (spreads, long options, diagonals). stop at -loss_fraction, take profit at +gain_fraction; time_exit uses short_leg_dte when the trade carries shorts, long_only_dte otherwise.

legs._comment: A short leg that has given up `capture` of its premium is bought back with its wings, whatever the trade does.

expiry._comment: Physically-settled legs are closed at or inside close_by_dte; roots listed as cash-settled settle instead.

portfolio._comment: The account as one book: beta-weighted delta (in SPY shares, on the broker's beta), theta per calendar day, the break-even move and a stress line. Retail heuristics with no published out-of-sample evidence, hence confidence 40. Guidance is REVIEW, naming what drives it. enabled: false turns all of it off; the reading is still recorded.

theta._comment: Theta as a share of net liq per day. Above max the book sells more gamma than the band allows; under min only informs.

delta._comment: BWD band: -short_per_theta x theta to +long_per_theta x theta SPY shares. With no positive theta, +/- the BWD whose 1% move costs fallback_pct_nlv_per_1pct of net liq.

breakeven._comment: A short-gamma book whose break-even SPY move is under this multiple of SPY's implied one-day move.

concentration._comment: One underlying over max_share of the book's gross theta or gross beta-weighted delta. A position can be excused with positions.<SYM>.disable.

beta_doubt._comment: Flag a broker beta whose sign disagrees with its three-month correlation (|corr| >= min_abs_corr), or that is near zero beside a strong correlation.

stress._comment: SPY shocks the book is repriced at, each underlying moved by beta x shock, IV and time held still.

_positions_comment: Per-underlying overrides, e.g. {"SPY": {"intent": "hedge", "disable": ["debit.stop"], "note": "portfolio hedge"}}. Rule ids: expiry, credit.take_profit, credit.stop, credit.time_exit, credit.breached, credit.close_before_earnings, debit.stop, debit.take_profit, debit.time_exit, legs.short_take_profit, roll.naked_put, roll.diagonal_short, directional.take_profit, directional.stop, ex_dividend, risk.oversize, portfolio.theta, portfolio.delta, portfolio.breakeven, portfolio.concentration
